principle: ASK THE MINIMUM NUMBER OF QUESTIONS REQUIRED TO REACH A SAFE, CONTRACTUAL OUTCOME.

question_priority_order.desc: Safety-critical inputs — asked before any price inputs. A positive safety answer may immediately stop estimation.
Questions that may redirect to another métier or specialist. Asked before eligibility.
Questions that narrow which canonical service applies.
Conditions that determine if service is in scope.
Numerical inputs needed to calculate price (ac_count, painted_m2, hours, etc.).

question_minimization_rules: Skip questions for inputs already known from entry context
Skip city questions — city has no pricing effect
Skip urgency questions — urgency has no pricing effect
Stop asking after all required conditions satisfied
Never ask full questionnaire before service identity resolved
Safety questions always asked even if not strictly required for price calculation
Routing questions asked before eligibility questions

planner_input_contract.required_conditions: array: from eligibility_conditions in canonical registry
planner_input_contract.hard_exclusions: array: from hard_exclusions in canonical registry
planner_input_contract.measurement_requirements: array: quantity input_ids for calculation model

planner_output_contract.next_question_id: string | null (null = no more questions needed)
planner_output_contract.blocking: boolean — false only if all inputs for calculation available
